basic_info.description: Elegantly updated Edwardian embraced by enchanting views, exceptional finishes, and an excellent location on the border of two extraordinary neighborhoods: Noe Valley and Eureka Valley. The tree-lined street and stately facade set the tone for this impeccably maintained home with the perfect balance of old-world warmth, modish flair, and open floor plan. An inviting entryway opens to a formal living room with fireplace and built-ins resplendent with period details, a dining room with distinctive views adjacent to the conveniently located half-bath, a tastefully updated gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances and views, and gorgeous wood floors showered with natural light. The dramatic staircase with skylight tube leads to a large and flexible primary bedroom with inspirational views, plenty of closet space, a remodeled bathroom, and the second spacious bedroom overlooking 22nd Street and beyond.  The upper level of the home also has wood floors and is graced with an abundance of natural light. There is a garage with interior access, plenty of room for storage, possible potential for future expansion, and with direct access to the intimate yard space with a hot tub. There are too many upgrades to list including AC so don't miss this special property that is close to everything!
